paper_title: Search for axion-like dark matter through nuclear spin precession in electric and magnetic fields
coupling_convention: amplitude of oscillating d_n - (mu_n/mu_Hg) d_Hg in e*cm
notes: First laboratory search for axion-DM-induced oscillating neutron EDM (axion-gluon coupling) plus an axion-wind nucleon-coupling search, using ILL (long time-base, 1e-9 to 1e-5 Hz) and PSI (short time-base, up to ~3.3 mHz) nEDM data over axion masses 1e-24 to 1e-17 eV. Primary published exclusion (Fig. 2) is the 95% C.L. limit on the oscillating EDM amplitude, ~(3-7)e-26 e*cm across the band; data points above are approximate values read from the described figure, converted from frequency to mass via m[eV]=4.136e-15*f[Hz]. The paper reinterprets these as limits on C_G/f_a (peak fa/CG ~ 1e21 GeV for ma <~ 1e-23 eV) and C_N/f_a (peak fa/CN ~ 4e5 GeV for 1e-19 to 1e-17 eV); no gluon-coupling enum exists, so AxionEDM with d_n in e*cm is used. The axion-wind result would map to AxionNeutron/nucleon coupling but is not encoded here. Assumes rho_DM = 0.4 GeV/cm^3.
